canonical_rule: Maturity is not enforcement. Release is not integration. Integration is not estate-wide enforcement.
notes: Conductellence remains canonical in its own repository.
FFOS runtime binding must not begin before Conductellence release closure and a versioned integration contract are available.
Individual consumer runtimes may reach VERIFIED_RUNTIME_BOUND without implying estate-wide ENFORCING state.
Repository anchor CI monitoring and runtime enforcement are distinct; never promote one from the other.
ProjectHub is a subsystem in the FFOS repository and shares that repository anchor; actual ProjectHub A3/A4/A5 enforcement must be independently verified.
The 31-repository master catalogue is an inventory layer; catalogue inclusion does not imply CDX governance, binding, runtime verification or enforcement.
Pius current canonical anchor state is ANCHOR_DECLARED / NOT_VERIFIED; legacy CI history must not promote it.
RFSU-godex has live binding drift recorded centrally; CareerHubZero has a live legacy manifest but no observed legacy binding-audit workflow.
reconciliation_note: consumer_bindings describes consequential application-runtime integration. Repository anchors are a separate axis. FFOS is CDX_CI_MONITORED but remains BOUND_PENDING_RUNTIME_INTEGRATION. Pius has a canonical anchor on main but remains ANCHOR_DECLARED / NOT_VERIFIED and repository-CI-only. Motherpher/form-flode has no canonical anchor on main; draft PR #34 is only a candidate, and its live legacy manifest identifies Hybrismannen/form-flode, so it must not be treated as admitted FFC binding. Core release and enforcement blockers remain open.

estate_catalog.rule: Registry inclusion is inventory only. Governance applicability, admission, binding, runtime verification and enforcement are separate states.
